sections.title: Prerequisites And Placement
sections.text: Requires an explicit open Design document and native component context, not an occurrence. name is nonblank; width,depth,height are positive length-expression strings (for example 40 mm or an existing parameter). No numeric dimensional values. plane defaults XY and accepts only a native ConstructionPlane, not a face. Use datum.plane for placement/orientation; coordinates are local to the resulting sketch origin. Ref inputs are unique names/aliases or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?} discovered via entity.list {kind:plane}. The recipe anchors a rectangle corner to sketch origin, adds driving width/depth dimensions, and extrudes along positive sketch normal as a new solid body. Expressions are retained, unlike raw sketch.geometry coordinates. name and name__section must be unused across native sketches/datums/features/bodies. No operation, center or overwrite option.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string,helpers:[SketchRef],recipe:box}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs; root ref is {kind:component,name:root}. No atomic/dependencies/isFullyConstrained key is added by primitive recipes. Envelope {success:boolean,operation:string,document:string,result:object,created:Ref[]} records internal helper geometry/constraints/dimensions and final feature; bodies are not individually appended by the feature handler. Batch b.result.helpers.0 feeds sketch.inspect.sketch, b.result.bodies.0 feeds body commands; name identifies the feature, not necessarily a body.

sections.title: Failure Safety
sections.text: Dimensions, support and reserved names are prechecked, but recipe is not atomic. Solver/kernel failure can leave Section helper and dimensions; ErrorFeatureHealthState raises after the final feature exists. Inspect existing helpers and health before retry. No rollback, save or automatic reuse. Offline tests do not certify regeneration geometry.

examples.label: Origin-corner block
examples.requires: Native component in an open Design; Block and Block__section unused.
examples.output: result.helpers[0] is the section sketch; result.bodies holds body refs, not a guaranteed body named Block.

verified: Complete primitive schema, dimensions and names
Helper order and primitive-only return fields

sections.title: Dimensions And Origin
sections.text: name is nonblank; radius,height are positive length-expression strings, with explicit units or existing length parameters. plane defaults XY; only a native construction-plane Ref in the selected component is accepted, not a face/proxy. Ref = unique name/alias or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}, discovered through entity.list {kind:plane}. Native component context only. Circle center is constrained to sketch origin and radius gets a driving radial dimension; extrusion height remains an expression. Coordinates are not an arbitrary center input. name and name__section must be unused across sketches/datums/features/bodies. New solid body only, positive normal; no operation/symmetric options.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string,helpers:[SketchRef],recipe:cylinder}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. No atomic/dependencies/isFullyConstrained keys. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} includes helper/geometry/constraint/dimension/final feature refs, not every result body. Batch s.result.helpers.0 is a sketch inspection input; s.result.bodies.0 is a body input. Kernel/solver failures can leave helpers or an unhealthy feature; no rollback/save or automatic reuse. Geometry/regeneration remain live checks.

examples.label: Literal-radius cylinder
examples.requires: Native component; Shaft and Shaft__section names unused. For shaft_diameter / 2 instead, first define and inspect a length parameter shaft_diameter with param.apply/param.inspect.
examples.output: result.feature identifies Shaft feature; result.helpers[0] allows inspection of its driving radius.

verified: Native support, origin constraint and radius equation
Exact helper/result fields

sections.title: Annular Section
sections.text: name is nonblank; outerRadius,innerRadius,height are positive length-expression strings; innerRadius must evaluate strictly below outerRadius. Expressions remain driving radii/height. Each circle center is constrained to sketch origin. plane defaults XY and must be a native ConstructionPlane in selected native component context, never an occurrence/face. Obtain support refs with entity.list {kind:plane}; Ref = unique name/alias or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}. name and name__section are reserved across native sketches/datums/features/bodies. The recipe selects exactly one profile with loopCount:2, without relying on profile tokens or indices; ambiguous/no annulus fails after sketch creation. New solid body only; no wall/thickness alternative field or arbitrary center.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string,helpers:[SketchRef],recipe:tube}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. No atomic/dependencies/isFullyConstrained field for this primitive. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} records internal created entities and final feature; bodies are not separately appended. Batch t.result.helpers.0 feeds sketch.inspect and t.result.bodies.0 a body command. No rollback/save; solver/kernel failure may leave named helpers/feature, so inspect before retry. Offline annulus selection tests do not prove live regeneration.

examples.label: Concentric tube
examples.requires: Native component with unused Tube/Tube__section. For innerRadius:25 mm - wall, first define a positive wall length parameter smaller than 25 mm.
examples.output: result.helpers[0] is the concentric-circle sketch; result.feature is the annular extrusion.

verified: Strict radii ordering and unique two-loop selection
Persistent dimensions and return fields

sections.title: Ring Is An Annulus
sections.text: Same annular extrusion construction as tube, not a torus. name is a nonblank unused feature name; outerRadius,innerRadius,height are positive length-expression strings and innerRadius < outerRadius. Height is axial thickness along positive sketch normal. Both center constraints and radius dimensions are persistent; use length parameters for equations. plane defaults XY and accepts only a native ConstructionPlane in selected native component context. Ref = actual unique name/alias or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}, discover via entity.list {kind:plane}. No face/occurrence/center/operation mode. name and name__section are pre-reserved across native sketches/datums/features/bodies; a unique two-loop profile is selected after geometry creation.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string,helpers:[SketchRef],recipe:ring}; Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. No atomic/dependencies/isFullyConstrained field. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} includes internal creations and final feature, not individual result bodies. Batch r.result.bodies.0 feeds a body operation; r.result.helpers.0 feeds sketch.inspect. Recipe is non-atomic despite lacking an atomic output key; solver/kernel failures can leave helpers or unhealthy feature. No save/rollback/reuse. Inspect before retry and validate geometry live.

examples.label: Flat washer
examples.requires: Open Design, native component and unused Washer/Washer__section names.
examples.output: result.recipe is ring; result.bodies are annular extrusion results, not toroidal surfaces.

verified: Ring/tube shared branch and strict dimensions
Primitive return without atomic key

sections.title: Two-Section Frustum
sections.text: name is nonblank; baseRadius,topRadius,height are positive length-expression strings. Zero-radius apex is rejected; equal radii are permitted. plane defaults XY, must be a native ConstructionPlane in selected native component context; no faces/occurrences. Ref = unique actual name/alias or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}, discover with entity.list {kind:plane}. Bottom and top circles are origin-centered and radius-dimensioned; top plane offset retains height expression, final solid loft joins the two profiles as newBody. name,name__section,name__top,name__topPlane must all be unused across sketches/datums/features/bodies. No hollow reducer, wall or apex mode; datum offset and solver/kernel feasibility remain native checks.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string,helpers:[bottomSketchRef,topPlaneDescription,topSketchRef],recipe:cone}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. Plane description is also a usable Ref plus objectType:string and API-available geometry/health/boundingBox/visibility fields (geometry numbers cm/rad; health description {value,name}). No atomic/dependencies/isFullyConstrained keys. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} records internal creations and final loft. Batch c.result.helpers.2 feeds sketch.inspect.sketch; c.result.bodies.0 feeds a body operation. Recipe is not atomic: failures can leave one/two sections and offset plane. No save, rollback or automatic reuse.

examples.label: Solid reducer frustum
examples.requires: Native component with all four reserved names unused and a design supporting the required datum/loft operations.
examples.output: result.helpers order is bottom sketch, offset plane, top sketch; result.feature is loft, not revolve.

verified: Offset-plane equation and two-section loft
Helper order and enriched datum reference

sections.title: Mode Selection And References
sections.text: Existing mode requires profile and axis, allows name,angle,operation only. profile is a native closed Profile, not a planar face: use sketch.inspect result.profiles[i].ref ({kind:profile,sketch:Ref,index:integer}); no index requires uniqueness, loopCount may select one matching profile instead. Generated mode requires name,profileData,axis and excludes profile. axis is an already-existing native axis/line/edge Ref or X/Y/Z, never a generated local label. Ref = unique actual name/alias or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}; discover with entity.list/selection.inspect. angle expression is (0,360 deg], default 360 deg, operation:newBody(default)|join|cut|intersect. No symmetric, solid or participants input. Generated mode reserves name and name__section across native sketches/datums/features/bodies before mutation and requires native component context. Existing mode also reserves a supplied name and consequently rejects occurrence context when name is supplied.

sections.title: Nested Profile Data
sections.text: profileData = {geometry:[...],plane?:Ref,constraints?:[],dimensions?:[],profileIndex?:nonnegative integer}; plane defaults XY and must be native ConstructionPlane. geometry is nonempty; each entry requires unique ASCII identifier name (origin reserved), type, exact fields: line start/end; arc center/start/sweep; arc3 start/through/end; circle center/radius; spline points array >=2; point point. Every point is three length-expression strings with sketch-local z evaluating within 1e-9 cm of zero. construction:boolean allowed except points; fixed/rectangle/unknown fields forbidden. Consecutive line/spline points must differ; arc has nonzero radius and 0<abs(sweep)<360 deg; arc3 noncollinear; circle radius positive. Raw coordinates/radius/sweep are evaluated initialization, NOT equations. profileIndex range/uniqueness is checked after creation. Without profileIndex exactly one profile must exist.

sections.title: Local Solver Schema
sections.text: constraints entries are exactly {type,entities:[selector strings]}; dimensions exactly {type,entities:[selectors],expression:string,text?:[three length expressions],orientation?:aligned|horizontal|vertical}. All dimensions drive; no driving:false. text defaults [10 mm,10 mm,0 mm], orientation allowed only distance, default aligned. Selectors: origin; primitive name; name.start/end on lines/arcs; name.center on arcs/circles; name.fitN on spline for zero-based in-range fit points. distance needs two points; angle two lines; radius/diameter one arc/circle. Constraints: horizontal/vertical one line; parallel/collinear two lines; horizontalPoints/verticalPoints two points; concentric two circular curves; coincident point then point/curve; midpoint point then line; perpendicular line then curve; tangent/smooth two curves; equal two lines or two circular curves; symmetry two same primitive types then line axis. Preflight checks names, types and expressions but not solver consistency. Explicit dimensions and constraints retain dependencies; unspecified geometry remains only partially parameterized.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Both modes return {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string}. Generated mode additionally returns helpers:[SketchRef],refs:{label:Ref,origin:PointRef,...},recipe:revolved_profile,atomic:false,dependencies:string,isFullyConstrained:boolean read from Fusion. refs adds literal keys name.fitN for splines; endpoint selectors are NOT separate keys. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null, optional component/occurrence refs. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} includes internal creations. Batch r.result.refs.cap is usable as a curve ref; use {entity:thatRef,point:center} for center. Dotted spline keys cannot be addressed with batch dot-path $ref; use returned concrete ref or sketch.inspect points instead. Existing mode does not add helpers/recipe/atomic/refs/dependencies/isFullyConstrained. Error health or solver/topology failure can leave generated sketch/features, no rollback/save. Generated profile is serialized to a token-bearing Ref before revolve, so a Fusion profile whose token does not round-trip can fail after helpers despite valid sketch selection.

examples.label: Existing section
examples.requires: Inspect native Section profile first and ensure suitable geometry for revolution about component Y.
examples.output: Only base feature result fields; no helpers or recipe marker.

examples.label: Dimensioned semicircular profile
examples.requires: Native component; TurnedPart and TurnedPart__section unused. Solver must accept the semicircle/diameter closure; no source geometry needed.
examples.output: result.refs.cap/base/origin and result.helpers[0] identify generated geometry; actual isFullyConstrained is reported, not assumed.

verified: Both branches and full primitive/solver schemas
Conditional result keys, dotted ref limits and profile-token handoff
bugs: Generated mode converts resolved profile to token-bearing ctx.ref before model.revolve; non-roundtripping Profile tokens can fail after helper creation, unlike primitive loopCount selectors.

sections.title: Generated And Existing Modes
sections.text: Without entities, generated mode requires name,pitchDiameter,quantity,diameter,depth and permits phase,reverse,participants only. Lengths are positive expression strings; phase signed angle expression default 0 deg, reverse:boolean false. quantity integer >=2 or existing unitless parameter-expression evaluating to integer >=2 includes seed; use numeric 6 rather than string "6" (the latter fails downstream generic expression validation). participants optional nonempty native body refs. Requires parametric history, component XY/Z and native component context with existing material in hole direction (default negative sketch normal). Seed coordinates are pitchDiameter/2*[cos(phase),sin(phase),0], retained in three offset-plane equations and linked datum projection, not fixed sketch coordinates. Pattern always full 360 deg about component Z; axis/angle forbidden. With entities, require nonempty native feature refs,axis,quantity; permit name and angle only. angle positive <=360 deg default 360 deg. Existing mode does not create hole helpers; diameter/depth/pitchDiameter/phase/reverse/participants forbidden.

sections.title: Discovery And Safety
sections.text: Ref = actual unique name/alias or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}. Obtain bodies via entity.list {kind:body} or prior result.bodies; seed features via entity.list {kind:feature} or prior result.feature. Never use body refs when feature seeds are required. Generated names reserve name,name__seed,name__section,name__center and name__center__x/__y/__z across sketches/datums/features/bodies. Existing mode reserves a supplied name and then also requires native component context. Invalid preflight inputs/collisions are no-op errors; kernel/projection/hole/pattern failure can leave helpers and seed. No save/rollback/overwrite/reuse. Actual intersections/overlap and regeneration are live checks.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Both modes return {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string}. Generated mode adds seed:{feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string}, helpers:[sketchRef,datumPointDescription,xPlaneRef,yPlaneRef,zPlaneRef],recipe:bolt_circle,dependencies:string,atomic:false. The point description contains normal Ref keys plus objectType and available geometry/health/visibility fields, representation:string and helpers:planeRef[3]. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. Existing mode adds none of these recipe keys. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} contains internal creations. Internally seed.feature feeds pattern.circular entities[0]. Batch b.result.seed.feature accesses generated seed; b.result.feature is final pattern. No per-hole location array or isFullyConstrained field is returned. Error feature health raises after mutation.

examples.label: Generated holes
examples.requires: Native parametric component with material beneath XY around 30 mm pitch radius; all reserved names unused. Default hole direction is negative Z.
examples.output: result.seed.feature is the native hole; result.feature the circular pattern, with five helpers.

examples.label: Pattern existing seed feature
examples.requires: SeedFeature must be an entity.alias for a discovered native hole/cut feature, e.g. model.hole result.feature, suitable for circular repetition.
examples.output: Only base pattern result fields; no generated seed/helper keys.

verified: Both mutually exclusive schemas and quantity validation
Coordinate equation dependencies and seed wiring
Helper ordering and partial pattern failure

sections.title: Modes And Dimensions
sections.text: Without profile, require name,length,width,thickness; permit position,angle,operation,symmetric,participants only. Lengths are positive expression strings with length > width; length is overall stadium length. position is three signed component-coordinate length-expression strings, default [0 mm,0 mm,0 mm]; angle is signed component +X-to-+Y angle expression default 0 deg. Plane remains parallel to XY at position[2]; cap centers are position +/- (length-width)/2*[cos(angle),sin(angle),0]. Three-plane coordinate datums retain signed equations and are linked into sketch; coincident cap centers plus radial width/2 dimension drive native stadium constraints. Requires parametric history and Sketch.addCenterToCenterSlot. With profile, require native closed Profile and thickness; allow name,operation,symmetric only, no participants or generated fields. Profile selector {kind:profile,sketch:Ref,index:integer} comes from sketch.inspect; omit index only if unique or use exclusive loopCount. operation:cut(default)|newBody|join|intersect; symmetric:boolean false, true uses total thickness. Positive normal one-sided, no throughAll or arbitrary plane mode.

sections.title: Scope And Failure
sections.text: Ref = actual unique name/alias or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}; discover bodies with entity.list or prior result.bodies. Generated participants is a nonempty native body-ref array for cut/intersect ONLY. Although wrapper preflight resolves bodies, incompatible operation+participants is rejected later by model.extrude after helpers/geometry exist. Generated mode requires native component context and reserves name,name__section,name__plane,name__start,name__end and each point's __x/__y/__z plane names across native sketches/datums/features/bodies. Existing mode reserves supplied name and rejects occurrence scope in that case. No save/rollback/reuse; solver/kernel/projection errors may leave helpers. Generated profile token roundtrip can also fail after helper creation. Inspect before retry. Offline dependency tests do not certify solver regeneration.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Both modes return {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string}. Generated adds slotGeometry:Ref[] (native slot-builder geometry, first two are cap arcs, followed by other builder entities, then the explicit radius dimension ref),helpers:[planeDescription,sketchRef,startPointDescription,startXPlaneRef,startYPlaneRef,startZPlaneRef,endPointDescription,endXPlaneRef,endYPlaneRef,endZPlaneRef],recipe:slot,dependencies:string,atomic:false. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. Datum descriptions additionally have objectType and API-available geometry/health/boundingBox/visibility fields; coordinate points also representation:string,helpers:Ref[3]. No isFullyConstrained or local refs map is added. Existing mode adds none of the recipe keys. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} records internal creations. Batch s.result.feature feeds shape.slot_pattern.entities[0]; s.result.helpers.1 feeds sketch.inspect only in generated mode. Error health raises after adding final feature.

examples.label: Generated standalone stadium
examples.requires: Native parametric component, supported slot API and all reserved names unused. newBody needs no material; do not supply participants.
examples.output: result.slotGeometry[0:2] are cap arcs and the final entry is radius dimension; result.feature is extrusion.

examples.label: Cut existing profile
examples.requires: Section has inspected native closed slot outline intersecting existing material over total 3 mm symmetric thickness.
examples.output: Base extrusion result only, no generated helpers/recipe/slotGeometry.

verified: Both schemas and slot dependency equations
Exact helper/geometry arrays and total thickness
Deferred participants rejection and profile token handoff
bugs: Generated slot with participants and operation newBody/join creates helpers and slot before model.extrude rejects participants; preflight fails to enforce conditional operation compatibility.
Generated slot sends ctx.ref(profile) to extrude; non-roundtripping Profile tokens can fail after geometry creation.

sections.title: Explicit Feature Seeds
sections.text: entities is a nonempty array of native feature refs, not bodies or slot curves. Use shape.slot result.feature or entity.list {kind:feature}; Ref = unique actual alias/name or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}. direction requires existing native axis/line/linear-edge Ref or X/Y/Z. quantity is integer >=2 or existing unitless parameter-expression evaluating to integer >=2, including seed; bare numeric strings are not accepted by downstream expression handling. distance is strictly positive length-expression string; distanceType:spacing(default)|extent. Native selected-component geometry only. name optional but if supplied must be unused across native sketches/datums/features/bodies and requires native component context. No second direction, outline generation, suppression or compute options. Expressions retain native count/spacing dependencies.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string} only. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. No helpers/recipe/atomic key. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} appends final pattern feature. Batch s.result.feature from shape.slot feeds this entities[0], and p.result.feature is the resulting rectangular pattern. No per-instance refs/transforms. Kernel overlap/feasibility remains live; error health raises after feature creation and partial changes can remain, no rollback/save.

examples.label: Repeat seed slot cut
examples.requires: Alias the actual shape.slot result.feature as SeedFeature using entity.alias, or substitute that returned ref. Existing material must support repeated cuts.
examples.output: result.feature is rectangular pattern; no slot helper sketch is generated.

verified: Feature-only subjects and stricter count/distance bounds
Native scope and unaugmented result

sections.title: Profile Extrusion
sections.text: Requires profile and thickness; permits name,operation,symmetric only. profile is a native closed Profile, not an open rib curve or planar face. Discover via sketch.inspect result.profiles[i].ref ({kind:profile,sketch:Ref,index:integer}); index omitted requires uniqueness, loopCount may select one matching profile instead of index. Ref = unique actual alias/name or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}. thickness must be a positive length-expression string retained as extrude distance. operation:join(default)|newBody|cut|intersect; symmetric:boolean false, true uses total thickness, false positive sketch normal. Native selected-component geometry only. A supplied name is reserved across native sketches/datums/features/bodies and requires native component scope. No participants, thin/open-curve rib, auto-extension or automatic position/dimensions for source sketch.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string}, no helpers/recipe/atomic/dependencies keys. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} appends extrusion feature only. Batch r.result.bodies.0 is usable in body commands if present. Join needs intersecting material; kernel validity remains live. Error health raises after feature creation, no rollback/save. Inspect partial changes before retry.

examples.label: Join a rib section
examples.requires: Create and inspect a native closed RibSection profile intersecting target solid; its own sketch dimensions control rib outline.
examples.output: result.feature is an Extrude feature, not Fusion's open-curve Rib UI feature.

verified: Closed-profile strict type and thickness remapping
Join default and unaugmented result

sections.title: Explicit Web Section
sections.text: Requires native closed profile and positive thickness-expression string; permits name,operation,symmetric only. Select profile from sketch.inspect result.profiles[i].ref: {kind:profile,sketch:Ref,index:integer}; no index requires exactly one profile, loopCount may select one unique matching profile instead. Ref = actual unique name/alias or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}. operation defaults join and permits newBody/cut/intersect; symmetric:boolean defaults false, true uses total extrusion distance. Source outline and placement must already be dimensioned; no face-to-face inference, open-curve web, auto-extension, participants or throughAll input. Native selected-component inputs only. A supplied name is checked across native sketches/datums/features/bodies and rejects occurrence context. Thickness is retained as native extrusion expression.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string}; Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. No recipe/helpers/atomic/dependencies fields are added. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} appends feature only. Batch w.result.feature is a feature-pattern seed; w.result.bodies.0 a body selection if present. Join requires material intersection. Error health raises after feature exists and other kernel failures may leave changes; no rollback/save. Inspect before retry; offline tests do not certify solver/geometry.

examples.label: Join explicit web section
examples.requires: Existing inspected native closed WebSection profile spanning intended structure and intersecting material over total 2 mm thickness.
examples.output: result.feature is a native extrusion; no helper sketch is generated.

verified: Web schema, selected scope and join semantics
Exact result keys

sections.title: Section And Modes
sections.text: profile always requires an existing native closed Profile (not face) selected from sketch.inspect result.profiles[i].ref: {kind:profile,sketch:Ref,index:integer}; omit index only if unique or use exclusive loopCount. Ref = unique actual alias/name or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?}. Existing mode requires path and permits name,operation,twist,taper only. path = {curves:[Ref,...],chain?:none|connected|tangent,kind?:path,name?:string}; use path.create result.path. Curves are nonempty common-owner/context sketch curves/edges; chaining needs one seed and connected accepts only sketch curves. Native selected-component inputs only. Generated mode requires name,profile,waypoints, permits plane,segments,interpolation,constraints,dimensions,operation,twist,taper and forbids path. Both modes use operation:newBody(default)|join|cut|intersect and optional angle-expression twist/taper. No participants/solid/orientation/guideRail fields. Position/orient the section for the path yourself; no automatic placement.

sections.title: Waypoints And Solver Lists
sections.text: waypoints has >=2 points, each exactly three length-expression strings; generated sketch is planar local XY with z within 1e-9 cm of zero. plane defaults XY, native ConstructionPlane only. interpolation:segments(default)|spline. segments, when present, has exactly waypoints.length-1 objects: {type:line} or {type:arc,through:[three length expressions]}; through is mandatory only arc and noncollinear with adjacent endpoints. Lines have distinct endpoints. Consecutive segment endpoints get coincident constraints automatically; do not duplicate these. Curves are named route0,route1,...; spline creates route0 through all points and forbids segments. Raw point/through expressions initialize only; no fixed curves or automatic tangent/elbow constraints. constraints is an array of {type,entities:[local selector strings]}; dimensions is {type,entities:[selectors],expression,text?:[three length expressions],orientation?:aligned|horizontal|vertical}, all driving. Selectors origin,routeN,routeN.start/end (line/arc),routeN.center (arc),route0.fitN (spline, in-range zero-based). distance:two points; angle:two lines; radius/diameter:one arc. text default [10 mm,10 mm,0 mm]; orientation distance-only. Constraints: horizontal/vertical one line; parallel/collinear two lines; horizontalPoints/verticalPoints two points; concentric two circular curves; coincident point then point/curve; midpoint point then line; perpendicular line then curve; tangent/smooth two curves; equal two lines or circular curves; symmetry two like primitive types then line. All schemas/selectors/expressions are prechecked, not solver feasibility.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Both modes return {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string}. Generated additionally returns path:{curves:Ref[],chain:none} (no kind/name),helpers:[SketchRef],refs:{routeN:Ref,origin:PointRef,...},recipe:route,atomic:false,dependencies:string,isFullyConstrained:boolean from Fusion. Spline refs adds literal route0.fitN keys, not endpoint keys. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} contains internal creations. Batch r.result.path feeds a later path consumer; r.result.refs.route0 feeds curve selection. Dotted fit-point map keys cannot be addressed by batch dot paths: use concrete returned ref or sketch.inspect points. Existing mode adds none of these recipe keys. Generated requires native component scope and unused name/name__route across sketches/datums/features/bodies; existing supplied name is likewise reserved. No rollback/save; solver/path/kernel errors can leave helper sketch/geometry/feature. Error feature health raises after creation. No 3D waypoint solver, bend optimizer or collision guarantee; geometry validation requires live Fusion.

examples.label: Existing path
examples.requires: SeedLine is a real alias for native path geometry discovered with sketch.inspect. Section is placed/oriented at its start.
examples.output: Base sweep result only; existing path is not echoed.

examples.label: Dimensioned straight route
examples.requires: Native DuctSection at route start, normal suitable for route along local XZ-sketch Y; Duct/Duct__route unused.
examples.output: result.path is reusable; result.refs.route0 and result.helpers[0] identify generated route.

sections.title: Generated Mode
sections.text: With schemaVersion:1 and frame:component, shape helix generates a real helical centerline (BRep recipe, never native Coil). radius is required; supply pitch (with optional turns) or turns+height, never pitch+height together. hand right (default) or left; startPhase an angular expression; tolerance a positive curve tolerance (default 0.01 mm). An optional section profile ref sweeps the generated helix. The result is a sampled helix plus fitted NURBS recipe with arc length, curvature and pitch; native persistent 3D helical path insertion is a declared gap.

sections.title: Existing-Path Mode
sections.text: Without generation inputs, profile and path are required. profile must be a native closed Profile (sketch.inspect result.profiles[i].ref). path = {curves:[Ref,...],chain?:none|connected|tangent,kind?:path,name?:string}. Geometry must be native selected-component. Permitted optional fields name,operation,twist,taper. Twist is section rotation, not pitch/turns. Source geometry owns pitch/radius dependencies; the handler does not certify that the path is helical.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Generated mode returns schemaVersion:1 with radius/pitch/turns/height/hand/startPhase, arcLength, curvature, samplePoints and representation:recipe (or blocked for representation:native). Existing-path mode returns {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string}. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} appends created refs. Kernel/error health failures may leave changes; no rollback/save. Offline stubs test dispatch, not helical geometry or regeneration.

examples.label: Sweep existing helical source
examples.requires: HelicalEdge is an actual entity.alias for a native helical BRep edge discovered via entity.list/selection.inspect, not a fabricated token. WireSection is suitably placed/oriented and small enough for sweep. Spring unused. For generated mode use schemaVersion:1 frame:component with radius plus pitch or turns+height.
examples.output: result.feature is sweep in existing-path mode; generated mode returns schemaVersion:1 recipe with arcLength/curvature.
